delta.note: This amendment to PMK 81/2024 covers only the use of book value (nilai buku) for asset transfers in mergers, consolidations, business splits and acquisitions, including those tied to BUMN restructuring. It concerns corporate income tax and the related application procedures. Nothing in it changes how PPh 21 is computed for permanent employees: no rates, PTKP, TER tables, deductions or social security treatment are affected.
